name: io.github.harrybuild/healthstylz-mcp
title: HealthStylz Clinical Nutrition, Calculators & Circadian Environment MCP
description: Free zero-auth nutrition, NIH supplement RCTs, 13 sports calculators, and sleep wellness MCP.

tools.name: get_daily_wellness_brief
tools.description: Get today's evidence-based health news wire, trending health topics, molecule of the day, and latest published stories.

tools.name: search_healthstylz_articles
tools.description: Search 1,126+ registered dietitian and evidence-grounded health, recipes, nutrition, movement, and wellness articles.

q.description: Search terms (e.g. salmon, resistance training, sleep hygiene, fiber)

topic.description: Optional topic filter: recipes, fitness, weight, supplements, aging, family, mind, drinks, decor

tools.name: lookup_supplement_evidence
tools.description: Look up adult RDA, Tolerable Upper Intake Level (UL), PubMed randomized clinical trial counts, and NIH guidance for 24+ common supplements.

supplement.description: Supplement slug or name (e.g. vitamin-d, magnesium, creatine, zinc, omega-3, ashwagandha)

tools.name: calculate_ag1_vs_multivitamin
tools.description: Calculate real AG1 cost per scoop ($2.30 to $3.60), annual household cost, and evaluate NIH Tolerable Upper Limit (UL) safety overlap with multivitamins.

days_per_week.description: Days per week you drink AG1 (1-7, default 7)

plan.description: Purchase tier: double-subscription ($2.30/scoop), single-subscription ($2.63/scoop), or one-time ($3.60/scoop with shipping)

taking_multivitamin.description: Whether user is concurrently taking a standard multivitamin

tools.name: get_curtain_guides
tools.description: List or read the 5 HealthStylz Curtain Guides (window measuring, holiday velvet, pleat and heading styles, fabric GSM and fibre, nursery darkness and safety). Specs come from official TWOPAGES product pages; unstated specs are reported as not stated.

slug.description: Guide slug for the full guide (takeaways, products, FAQ, sources). Omit to list all guides.

q.description: Optional search words (e.g. velvet, nursery, pinch pleat, gsm, measure)

tools.name: get_herb_guides
tools.description: List or read the HealthStylz Herb Guides (loose leaf tea brewing, evening and afternoon herbal teas, homemade vs store-bought elderberry syrup, warming spice teas, seasonal guides). Product facts, prices and precautions come from Mountain Rose Herbs product pages; no health claims.

slug.description: Guide slug for the full guide (takeaways, products with listed prices, FAQ, sources). Omit to list all guides.

q.description: Optional search words (e.g. chamomile, matcha, elderberry, chai, rooibos, gift)

tools.name: get_curtain_window_wellness_specs
tools.description: Get residential circadian wellness window specifications: fabric GSM weights, blackout percentage, acoustic dampening, and fullness sizing formulas.

room_type.description: Target room type for light/circadian and acoustic optimization

tools.name: get_health_tools
tools.description: List or inspect HealthStylz interactive calculators and 3D labs (protein intake, daily water intake, steps to miles and calories, calorie deficit and USDA food swaps, AG1 overlap, and 3D Curtain Window Lab) with their sourced formulas.

tool.description: Optional tool slug (protein, water, steps, calorie-deficit, tdee, bmr, one-rep-max, ffmi, vo2-max, sleep-cycle, heart-rate-zones, caffeine-half-life, fiber, ag1-calculator, window-lab). Omit to list all tools.

tools.name: run_healthstylz_calculator
tools.description: Run recognized clinical and sports science calculators (tdee, bmr, one-rep-max, ffmi, vo2-max, sleep-cycle, heart-rate-zones, caffeine-half-life, fiber, protein, water, steps, calorie-deficit) with typed parameters, returning structured calculations, scientific citations, and clinical guidance.

max_hr.description: Measured maximum heart rate in bpm

walk_time_minutes.description: Walk duration in minutes for Rockport walk

post_walk_hr.description: Immediate post-walk heart rate in bpm

distance_meters.description: Distance covered in meters for Cooper 12-min run

daily_calories.description: Daily energy intake in kcal for fiber calculation

current_fiber_g.description: Current daily fiber intake in grams

who.description: Target category for protein/water (adult, older, active, loss, preg, woman, man)

daily_calories_cut.description: Daily calories cut for deficit planner
